title: Surgical Feature-Space Decomposition of LLMs: Why, When and How?
findings: The proposed compression method, Surgical Feature-Space Decomposition (SFSD), substantially reduces religious bias in the LLaMA-7B and Mistral-7B models. As the models are compressed to 90% and 80% of their original size, their Idealized Context Association Test (ICAT) scores for the religion category increase, indicating a reduction in stereotypical bias.
